requirements.title: REAL result type and kind follow A and KIND cases
requirements.definition: The REAL result has real type. KIND presence selects the result kind for integer, real, complex, and BOZ A; KIND absence selects default real kind for integer, real, or BOZ A and selects A's real kind for complex A.

pending.REAL-result-real-type: Compile positive controls assigning REAL(7), REAL(1.0D0), REAL(CMPLX(2.0,-5.0)), and REAL(Z'00000000') to real variables and passing them to a real dummy procedure; source-control mutation changes the receiving context to integer.
pending.REAL-integer-real-KIND-present: Use REAL(7,KIND=KIND(1.0D0)) and REAL(1.0,KIND=KIND(1.0D0)); assert KIND of each result equals KIND(1.0D0) and mutate KIND to default real kind.
pending.REAL-integer-real-default-kind-absent: Use REAL(7) and REAL(1.0D0) without KIND; assert KIND of each result equals KIND(1.0) and pair the nondefault real input with the KIND-present control.
pending.REAL-complex-KIND-present: Use REAL(CMPLX(2.0,-5.0),KIND=KIND(1.0D0)); assert result KIND equals KIND(1.0D0) and mutate the KIND argument to default real kind.
pending.REAL-complex-kind-from-A-absent: Use a complex actual with nondefault real kind selected by a named constant; assert KIND(REAL(z)) equals the kind of the real part and mutate z to default complex.
pending.REAL-BOZ-KIND-present: Use a real BOZ actual argument such as REAL(Z'00000000',KIND=KIND(1.0)); assert KIND of the result equals the supplied real kind and mutate the KIND argument.
pending.REAL-BOZ-default-kind-absent: Use REAL(Z'00000000') and assert KIND of the result equals KIND(1.0); companion REAL(Z'00000000',KIND=KIND(1.0)) guards against an absent-KIND special case.
